data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 摄影棚聚光灯下露肩洋装的超模气场
data.description: 专业时尚摄影棚内，作为人气现役模特的绫濑身着墨绿修身露肩高定洋装，亭亭玉立于聚光灯下，展现顶级美少女模特的无可挑剔优雅。
data.location: 专业时尚摄影棚无影背景前
data.action: 单手叉腰侧身而立，黑长直秀发自然垂于单侧胸前，眼神专注自信，嘴角挂着职业又迷人的微笑
data.lighting: 多角度专业柔光箱与强轮廓聚光灯，雕刻出精致立体的五官与肩颈线条
data.camera: 全身侧立三分视角，符合高端时尚杂志封面构图
data.promptProse: Ayase Aragaki commands the center of a high-end photography studio, showcasing her professional modeling grace under powerful studio strobes. Dressed in a sophisticated emerald-green off-the-shoulder couture gown that hugs her slender silhouette, she stands with one hand resting poised on her hip. Rim lighting carves out her refined jawline and porcelain collarbones, her dark gaze projecting confident elegance.
data.animaCaption: Standing poised under the studio spotlights in an emerald off-shoulder dress, Ayase radiates refined supermodel charisma.
